segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: The breakdown of the budget, and we have made a general breakdown here in this slide,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: shows that the budget is divided into several components.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: First of all, the budget covers the organizational outcome one,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: which is really the repair, maintenance, and the building of national roads and bridges,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: or the National Roads and Bridges Program.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Roughly 200 billion.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: The Foreign Assisted Projects Program, these are covered by the various official development assistance loans,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: and comprise of the big ticket flagship projects, not only of the PWH, but of the entire government.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Roughly about 118 billion.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: The, and for this year, as we all know po, nung 2026,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: dinesisyonan po ng both executive at ng kongreso na wala munang flood mitigation program na locally funded.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kaya, pero po ngayong 2027,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: 2027 meron na po, at ang locally funded projects po natin for 2027 ay 83.84 billion.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero meron din po tayong Foreign Assisted Ongoing Flood Mitigation Projects.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasama po ito dun sa 117 billion Foreign Assisted Projects worth 19 billion.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron din po tayong Basic Infrastructure Program.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Divided into 105 billion for access roads and bridges.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: From the national roads leading to major strategic facilities.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron po tayong 40.97 billion multipurpose buildings to support social services.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron din po tayong coastal roads to augment resiliency na 1.38 billion.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And meron din po tayong 419 million for local ports.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: These four components form part of the Basic Infrastructure Program.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron din po 510 million na construction and rehabilitation for PWDs and elderlies as mandated by law.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron din po tayong 1 billion rehabilitation of disaster infrastructure.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito po yung ating commonly termed as yung,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Quick Response Fund natin during calamities.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And meron din pong 7.29 billion na construction and rehabilitation of water supply as mandated by the 1989 Republic Act on Water Supply.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Yung batas po natin on water supply.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Apart from this po, meron din po tayo yung ating automatic appropriations which essentially cover,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: personal services, maintenance and other operating expenses.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And meron din po tayong support to operations.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito po yung mga feasibility studies natin, mga detailed engineering natin,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: mga ating mga studies to make plans and programs.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Right of way worth 27.3 billion.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And finally yung general administration and support po na 2.77 billion.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: The details of which we can provide the committee as well.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And which has already provided in the current draft of the, in the National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So this gives us a bird's eye view po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Now if kumamagapatin niyo po, I will now proceed with the budget reforms that we have initiated over the course of the past 11 months.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Unang-una po, mag-start po tayo sa basics.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Uunahin ko na po na skin-wrap na po natin yung formula na,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: yung tinatawag nilang parametric formula na ginagamit nung nakaraang mga ilang taon.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: We simplified the allocations to be based on three core components.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: First of all po, ang utos po ng ating Pangulo,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: i-prioritize yung mga nakatenga o hindi tapos.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So we are prioritizing, trying to complete in some cases within the next fiscal year,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: in most cases, dahil po maglalaki pa ang requirements,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: in succeeding years, yung mga nakatenga o unfinished nating mga proyekto.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ikalawa po, importante din po sa Pangulo, ay yung mandato ng DPWH na i-prioritize ang maintenance and repair of critical infrastructure.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito yung ating mga national roads and national bridges.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At kasama na rin po yung mga flood mitigation infrastructures na nasisira.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Nakita naman natin nitong mga nakaraang mga dumaan na bagyo.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kailangan din po i-repair po yan ng mabilisan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And i-address din po yung immediate needs ng mga communities,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: which are covered mostly by the basic infrastructure program o yung BIT program natin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Base po dito, nag-implement po tayo ng very, very strict evaluation

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: project evaluation system.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Unang-una po, pinagakas po natin ang technical and project vetting.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Makikita po natin ito sa mga susunod na slide kung ano po ang ginawa natin

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: para masigurado na ang mga project ay talagang na-vet ng maayos.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Yung pagsisigurado po, alimbawa, na mayroong mga plano, lahat ng mga project,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: hindi po tulad ng dati na madalas ang nangyayari, project title lang po at cost ang pumapasok

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: sa NEP.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Wala po yung marami po dyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Wala pong mga plano, wala pong mga FS, hindi po basis sa mga existing master plans natin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ikarawa po, we are improving project information and traceability.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: I-upload po namin, hindi lang po yung mga project titles na nandito sa NEP,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: kundi i-upload din po namin lahat po ng supporting documents ng lahat ng mga project

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na nakapaloob sa NEP para po makita lang, hindi lamang ng ating honorable committee,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: pero makita din po ng buong publiko.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At ikatro po, very, very strict po tayo ngayon sa mga mandatory documentary requirements

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: which I will expound on in the coming slides.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Sinisigurado na po natin ngayon, kagaya nung nasabi ko kanina,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na hindi lang project title at cost ang nakapaloob sa National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Nandito na rin po ang lahat ng supporting mandatory requirements ng bawat proyekto.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At ito po, next slide, ito po ang stringent project requirements po natin ngayon.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Lahat po ng proyekto na nakapaloob dito sa National Expenditure Program natin

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ay dapat merong approved program of work.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito po yung kabilin-bilina ng ating Pangulo, dahil nga po siya mismo nakita niya for himself,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na kapag po nung nag-expect siya po siya ng mga iba't ibang proyekto,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: madalas po pag humihingi siya ng plano, wala pong ma-produce na plano ang DPWH.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At ito po ay nasa level na ng implementation.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ito po, rinirequire na po natin ang plano,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ngayong parang po na ipapaloob pa natin lang sa budget ang mga proyektong nakapaloob sa National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ikaliwa po, yung validated geo-tagged photos.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: I will, if you will allow me to explain ano ang pagkakaiba po nung ginawa namin ngayon dun sa ginawa dati.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dati po, and I think we have all seen this in the height of the flood control scandal,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: madalas po sa mga geo-tagging na nangyari o mga coordinates na nangyari,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: pagdating po sa pre-planning, sa planning stage, meaning sa pagpasok po ng mga proyekto sa budget,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: either wala pong coordinates or kung meron man, ito po ay tinatawag nating tabletop coordinates lang.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meaning, ginugel map, tapos inupload po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At marami pa po sa mga proyekto, wala. Ni ito, wala. Noong itong nakaraan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meaning po, alam naman po natin, sanay naman po tayo sa mga apps natin sa telepono,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: required po silang mag-upload on-site ng geotag photos na nandun mismo ang picture ng lugar,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: kasama yung coordinates na geotag mismo.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, hindi na po pwede yung nasa opisina lang po sila at google map sila at igagagay nila kung saan saan na lang.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Hindi na po pwede yun.

segments.text: The project engineers, the district engineers, the planning engineers need to go on-site

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: and photograph the site with the coordinates attached automatically to the photos.

segments.text: Ikatlo po, requirement po ito ng Department of Budget Management,

segments.text: yung required BP-202 compliance forms na nakapaloob po dyan lahat ng information tungkol sa proyekto.

segments.text: Unang-una po, lahat po ng local projects, kami po ay ginagay na po namin sa isang basic infrastructure program na lang.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: we have anecdotal stories from Cagayan, for example po, sa Tugay Garaw.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Na-minimize po ang baha sa Tugay Garaw. Dahil po talagang grabe po ang dredging natin since December dyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Sa mouth ng Tugay Garaw Riverbed.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: However, dahil po dyan, lumalabas na po ang tubig.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ganyan din po ang nakikita natin sa ibang lugar.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, we really just have to...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Sa Maguindanao din po, sabi po ni Congressman Toto, Mangudadato,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ang laki po nang nakita nilang improvement sa levels ng floodwaters.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And typically po, ang Central Mindanao, grabe po ang baha dyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dahil dyan po lahat ng bagsak ng tubig from Central Mindanao, from Bukidnon, Davao, Cotabato, dyan po lahat.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Sa Mindanao at sa Cotabato, ang bagsak ng tubig.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, we really need to do more of this.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And, of course, we have other special support programs.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: In particular po, and I just want to emphasize this,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: marami po tayong mga bridge, sa limbawa, ditong sa Bungabong sa Oriental Mindoro.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And we have seen this all on social media.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: These are bridges that are just being built by the communities.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mostly being used by students.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: We have to fix this po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron po kaming ginawa nito sa Adno sa Pangasinan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: I don't know if we have pictures of that.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But, nakakaawa po talaga.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And we need a program for this.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: To build these makeshift bridges.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And to already build very long, yung mga tatagal na pong mga tulay na matibay na.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Para po sa mga studyante, para sa mga communities po,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na makakadaan po ang tao, makakadaan po ang trice.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Para po si Kel, para lang po madaanan ang mga iba't-ibang mga kababayan na.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And finally po, yung National Building Program.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: This is the last slide po, Mr. Pasensya na po, medyo tumagal.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Nakailangan din po natin, marami pong mga unfinished na buildings tayo.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: From national to local.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At yun nga po, nakakagungkot lang po dahil sa sobrang dami,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: kailangan din po talagang i-prioritize kung ano ang uunahin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kaya kailangan po talaga ang priority natin, yung mga ongoing para po matapos na.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Marami po dyan, from national government agencies to schools, to hospitals,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: to multi-purpose buildings all over the country, kailangan po natin tapusin yan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So, and this is where we will need your help po para ma-prioritize at masigurado pong matapos ang mga building na ito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Again po,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: We submit to the wisdom of Congress.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: This is our proposal.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: It is by no means perfect.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Hindi po namin sinasabi yun.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But we feel that it is a start really to try and institute these long and much needed reforms in the DPWH.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Not only to ensure na maproteksyonan ng pera ng mga kababayan natin from what we have seen already in the past.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And I'm not just talking about the recent flood control scandal.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But also to really build the right infrastructure na talagang kailangan po ng mga kababayan natin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: With that po, Mr. Chairman, honorable members, I will end my presentation.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But any additional information po, we will provide immediately po to the honorable members of the committee.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat po.

segments.text: Thank you. Thank you very much, Secretary Vince, for that very short presentation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Romeo S. Momo Sr.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, salamat sa magandang presentation ng

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Secretary of Public Works and Highways.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, dito sa proposed National Road System,

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: mayroong 199.58 billion.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Kasama ba dito ang pag-four lanes ng Maharlika Highway?

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Kasi napakaganda na yung ginawa ninyo sa Maharlika Highway.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Sana tuloy-tuloy na po. Pero may mga two lanes pa rin.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Sana matuloy po natin maging four lanes.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Lalo na yung Samar area, maganda na.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Thank you po, Mr. Chairman, Minority Leader.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Meron pong mga segments na may widening tayo.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero I have to admit po, ako po mismo ang nagsabi na

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: i-minimize natin yung widening. And I will respond po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi po, sabi ko po sa mga regions po,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: sa mga regions natin, kung pwede, unahin po muna namin,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: bago mag-widen, ayusin po na natin yung mga sira-sira.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi unfortunately po, lalo na po sa areas ng Bicol,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: some areas ng Central Luzon, some areas ng Region 4A,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: lalo na po sa Quezon, some areas ng Northern Samar at Samar,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: marami pong talagang sira-sira.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At yun po talaga ang pinaprioritize natin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: In Mindanao, it's the same.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero po, pag ayos na naman po yun, then okay na pong mag-widen.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero ang kailangan nga talaga sa widening, masigurado po na merong right of way.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi minsan po, ang napansin din po namin,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: nag-a-allocate po ng pondo for widening ng Mahalika, pero wala namang right of way.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So ang nangyayari po, nawawiden, isang kilometro, biglang napuputol.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So while important po talaga yung widening, Mr. Chairman, Minority Leader,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: we are trying to rationalize it in that way po.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But rest assured po, yung Northern Samar to Samar, because these are the most,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: one of the most dilapidated sections, priority po talaga natin yan, Mr. Chairman, Mr. Minority Leader.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Pangalawa po, Mr. Chairman, ito pong isang napaka-importanting project natin

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: na lagyan natin ng pondo ng 2026 yung for the feasibility study of the Sorsogon-Samar bridge link.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Pwede bang ma-update kami dito kung ano na yung napaka-vital na connector bridge na ito?

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Sa Luzon, Samar, Visayas, at Mindanao, napakahalaga po ito sa ating ekonomiya.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: At kung maaari po, mabrief ninyo kami ng status report kung ano na ang sitwasyon dito sa gagawin nating tulay.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chairman, Minority Leader.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Napaka-importante po ng Matnog-Allen Bridge, or ngayon is the Sorsogon-Northern Samar Bridge.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: This is a critical link part of the Maharlika network connecting Luzon to the Visayas.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: This is very close to my heart, and I know very close to the heart of the Minority Leader, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi nung ako po ay flagship sekretary po ng previous administration, priority po ito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Unfortunately, during that time, it was thought to be unimplementable

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: because of the depth of the channel in between.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Sorsogon and Northern Samar.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero I am happy po to report today, as promised po to the Minority Leader last time,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na we will allocate the much needed feasibility study for this,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: and we have 120 million pesos allocated for this in the 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And if I may be allowed, Mr. Chairman, to just present to the committee and to the Honorable Minority Leader,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: meron na pong solusyon.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, dati po yung original plan, and I'm sure the Minority Leader is very familiar,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Diretso po tayo matnog to Allen via the open sea, via the channel.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: This was...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: deemed to be unimplementable because of the depth of that channel.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ngayon po, yung designer po, ito po yung designer mismo ng Bataan Cavite Link Bridge,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: T.Y. Lin of the United States.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: They're the ones that have built all these iconic bridges all over the country,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: including the Bay Bridge in San Francisco, many bridges in the Middle East, in Europe.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Sila po ang nag-design ng Bataan-Cavite Link Bridge.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Sila po ang nakahanap ng solusyon.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: This is one of the biggest design companies for bridges in the world.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: They designed it in a way where it will connect to, sorry,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ay sorry po, 130 million po pala ngayong GAA itong feasibility studies.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ngayong 2026, hindi po 2027.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: 130 million for 2026 po pala ito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Nagsisimula na po ito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And kasama na po itong study na ito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dadaan po tayo sa Capul Island.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Tama po ba, Mr. Chairman?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: I think this is also a major tourist destination.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: At susunod po sa, anong island yan? Sorry.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Dinalupihan Island.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And then papasok na po sa Northern Samar.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So this not only addresses the engineering challenge,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na dadaan sa malalim na tubig,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: it actually also makes it cheaper.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mas magiging mura po itong tulay na ito

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: dahil po dadaan na tayo dito sa dalawang isla na ito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Similar po dun sa ginawa nilang design sa Bataan Cavite

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: na dumadaan sa Corregidor.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: May dadaan ng isang isla sa gitna yung Corridor Island.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: So I'm happy to report po na nagkakalinaw na po tayo

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: dito sa ating Sorsogon Samar Link Bridge.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Magandang balita yan, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Mukhang malapit na tayo mapunta ng Surigao dito

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: at saka kaya sa Cagayan de Oro.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Kaya masayang-masaya ang pinsan ko si Kong Rufus.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, ilang-ilang...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Sorry po, Minority.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Speaking of that po, Honorable Chairman,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: ine-next na po natin yung Southern Leyte to Surigao.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, may budget ngayon sa NIP natin na

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: P350 million for feasibility study for Mindanao-Leyte Bridge Link.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: So napakaganda nitong dalawang proyekto.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Anyway, ilang kilometro po ba ang nangyayari

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: pag ginawa natin itong Dinalupihan, yung Allen

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Dinalupihan, Capul, Matnog, or Sorsogon Bridge?

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Nagiging ilang kilometro?

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Together with the...

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Yung nasa isla...

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Yung nasa isla po na dadaan sa dalawang isla.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: It is roughly about 20 kilometers.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: It will be the...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Once it is done,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: and once the Bataan-Cavite Link Bridge is done,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: it will be the second longest bridge in the country.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Second to Bataan-Cavite Link Bridge.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: So, Mr. Chairman, mas maiksi pala ito

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: kaysa Bataan-Cavite Bridge.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Mas maiksi ito.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: 20 kilometers lang ito.

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Ang pangatlong tanong, Mr. Chairman,

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: sa economic rate of return,

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: itong napaka-importante pag mag-de-decide tayo

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: ng ganitong mega-structures,

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: ano ang mas malaking economic rate of return?

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Yung Cavite-Bataan Bridge or yung Sorsogon-Samar Bridge Link?

segments.speaker: Minority Leader Marcelino C. Libanan
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, maganda po yung...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Napakaganda po yung tanong.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Again po, Maharlika network po ito

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: kasi Sorsogon ay Bicol to Northern Samar.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mataas po ang Cavite-Bataan Link Bridge.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: 33% po ang economic rate of return.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero po ang Bicol to Samar Link Bridge

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Parang yan din po yung bilang nung nandun sa isumbong sa Pangulo na site eh. So I was actually expecting more. Pero sige po, lihis lang po ako ng konti.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kasama po ba dun sa ating mga dahilan ng pag-blacklist yung labor violations?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And would the good Secretary consider endorsing ito pong violation ng labor standards at labor rights as a guideline for blacklisting of contractors?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Absolutely po, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair, Mr. Secretary, sapagkat ito pong nagpigil para ma-implement ang wage hike dito po sa NCR.

segments.text: Maliit na nga po iyong 85 pesos, pinigilan pa, ay dalawa pong contractor. Yung isa po doon, I understand, milyon-milyon ang kontrata, lahat sa DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Chair, may we direct DPWH, through the committee, to kindly submit to this committee the list of projects in the last three years awarded to Redicon.

segments.text: Mr. Chair, gusto ko lang din pong balikan yung issue ng safety and accessibility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa ngayon po kasi, isa itong usapin na talagang matindi yung naging gap in the last few years, particularly po sa ating public infrastructure.

segments.text: Kanina lamang po, may ka-meeting ako ng mga PWD leaders sa aking opisina, and lo and behold, when they asked kung may PWD parking ang Kongreso,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: ang sabi, walang PWD parking, House of Representatives. Nakalulungkot po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa isang PWD event po, may na-meet po ako ng isang rapper.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ang pangalang po ng rapper, The Righteous One.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At ang sabi po ni The Righteous One, para sa kanila ng mga PWD,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: ang good governance simply means kapag umaandar ang elevator sa MRT.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Alam ko po, hindi kasama ang MRT sa coverage ng area of work ng DPWH.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero, inuulit ko po, good governance for our PWD siblings is as simple as accessibility infrastructure, for our PWD brothers and sisters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ano po ang assessment ang DPWH sa compliance sa BP344 or the Accessibility Law, especially across its road and infrastructure projects?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Halimbawa po, may datos po ba tayo kung ilang DPWH projects ang compliant sa accessibility standards ng gobyerno?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: With the permission of the... I will answer this very directly.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: It's... It's...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: What word can I use?

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Terrible compliance to the accessibility law.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: I mean, kitang-kita naman po natin yung mga kalsada natin, walang sidewalk eh.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: No, kaya nga po, slowly but surely, pinapakita po natin na pwede natin gawin ng tama.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Halimbawa po, EDSA.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Ako po mismo, sinamahan ko po yung mga mobility advocates natin, yung mga PWDs natin.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Hindi po pwedeng maglakad at mag-commute ang mga PWDs natin sa EDSA.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Kasi mamamatay po siya, masasagasaan po siya dyan.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But now, with the rehab, we are making sure that we are widening them.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Not only widening the sidewalk, but we are providing for the standards that are in the accessibility law.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But unfortunately, hindi po ito nai-implement sa buong Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: And malayo pa po ang kailangan natin marating dito.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero yun po, kaya nga po, from about 100 million in...

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: 170 million

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: last year, for PWD infrastructure, tinaas po natin ito to 500 million this year.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero kulang pa rin po yan, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: But ngayon po, ang instructions po natin sa ating mga DEOs at RDs,

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: kailangan po yung mga kagaya natin, kailangan may rampa, kailangan may sidewalk na wide enough.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Pero malayo pa po ang ating kailangan marating bago tayo umabot sa full compliance with the accessibility law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair, Mr. Secretary. For the very transparent and candid response. Tatanungin ko po sana kung ilang footbridge natin sa Metro Manila ang may functioning elevator. Pero batay po sa sagot nyo, alam ko na agad ang magiging tugon. Nakakarimarim po at nakakabiyak ng puso ito pong failure ng ating public infrastructure para po bigyan ng access ang mga kapatid nating PWD. Inuulit ko po, sabi ni Righteous One, para sa kanya, simple lang ang good governance. May umaandar na elevator sa footbridge, may umaandar na elevator sa MRT. At meron pa po pong nakausap kanina, sabi niya, simple lang ang good governance sa kanila, yung kakasya ang wheelchair sa sidewalk. Apparently, when you go through Metro Manila, maraming sidewalk, hindi kakasya ang wheelchair. So yan po yung nakakarimarim na kalagayan ng public infrastructure and issue of accessibility in this country.

segments.speaker: DPWH Secretary Vivencio B. Dizon
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, we could not agree more with the Honorable Cendaña.
